shared_elements: human figure with raised/extended arm holding an object
repeated small motifs arranged in rows
justification: Both surfaces depict standing anthropomorphic figures with arms raised or extended holding objects, and both include disc/circle motifs and repeated small elements, which is about as generic as figural iconography gets. A is a single large, densely detailed, elaborately costumed figure filling a tall panel in a naturalistic-with-ornament idiom, whereas B is a scattered field of many tiny stick-like outline figures alongside boats and a large ring, with no compositional or stylistic convention in common.
